# Joint Commission Survey Readiness

- **Goal / definition of done:** close all findings from the **June 2026** Joint Commission
  survey, submit an accepted **Plan of Correction (POC)**, and restore a clean accreditation
  record (deemed status for CMS).
- **Owner:** [Ellen Vasquez](../people/ellen-vasquez.md) (VP Quality); Diane co-signs the POC;
  Compliance review by [Nathan Cole](../people/nathan-cole.md).
- **Status:** active and **time-critical** — the POC is **overdue** (see
  [commitments](../commitments.md)).

## Findings (June 2026 survey)
- **Environment of Care / Life Safety** — several fire-barrier and egress deficiencies at the
  flagship.
- **Medication management** — inconsistent high-alert medication labeling and storage.

## Contacts
